PodMates Sync

Keep everyone's saved decks and Chronicles in sync across phones — no accounts, no server. Export your library, send it to the group, and everyone merges it into their own.

How this works — read first

There's no shared server here, so each person's phone holds its own saved decks, Pods, and Chronicles. Export bundles all three into text you can send. Import & Merge folds someone else's text into yours, without deleting anything you already have.

If you're viewing this in a plain HTML viewer app rather than a full browser (common on phones, and likely how your podmates will use it too), stick to copy and paste — it's the one method that works essentially everywhere, since it doesn't depend on the app supporting file downloads or file pickers, which many lightweight viewers don't. The download button and "pick a file" option are there as a bonus in case your specific viewer happens to support them, but don't rely on them.

Decks and Pods merge as "latest wins." If one only exists on one side, it's added. If it exists on both sides, whichever was saved more recently wins — nobody has to manually resolve anything.

Chronicles merge differently, on purpose. A deck has one current version, but a night at the table might have write-ups from more than one person — that's a feature, not a conflict. So Chronicles entries are never overwritten; anything genuinely new is added, and only exact duplicates (the same entry arriving twice) are skipped. Two different accounts of the same night both stay.

One thing worth knowing: deleting a deck locally doesn't remove it from anyone else's copy. If an older export gets merged in later, a deck you deleted can reappear. For a small pod this is rarely worth worrying about — just delete it again locally if it resurfaces.

Suggested workflow for a pod using a group chat (e.g. LINE): one person acts as the hub. Everyone exports and sends their text to the hub whenever they've added something new (as a pasted message, or a text file if that's easier). The hub merges each one in as it arrives. Periodically — or right after an event — the hub exports the now-combined library and sends it back out. Everyone merges that in, and the whole pod converges without anyone needing to be online at the same time.
